info.title: relay-guest-api: the control plane
info.summary: What the relay serves the build environment on port 8300: its health, its authority, the build's output and its completion.
info.description: The control plane of the relay's guest API, as a conforming build environment uses it. The requirements of relay-guest-api/v1.md are normative and this file describes only what they state. What it cannot say is in that document alone: routing by the request's target host (that of an absolute URL, or else the Host) whatever its port, on port 80 and inside TLS on port 443; the link below HTTP (DHCP, ARP, DNS); the ordering, completion as terminal, and the timing of the heartbeat; the differences by mode; and the known divergences. /v1/output and /v1/complete take POST only (405 otherwise, GUEST-40); any other clean path is 404; the reply to a path that is not clean is not defined (GUEST-40).

servers.description: Port 8300 of the relay's address; on a frame link, of any address (GUEST-35).

relay.description: The relay's address on the build link.

200.description: The relay's certificate authority, the same bytes as the claim reply's ca_cert; not recorded.

post.summary: Forward the build's console output to the collector

requestBody.description: Console output, in order, whatever the Content-Type; at most 256 MiB in all for one build.

200.description: The collector took the output. Empty body.

413.description: output limit exceeded, and a line feed.

500.description: The collector did not take the output; the body says why.

post.summary: Complete the build with its exit code

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The exit code, a decimal integer that fits a signed 64-bit integer; 0 when absent or empty.

200.description: The build is complete. Empty body.
